framework.primary_law: Act on Promotion of Research, Development and Utilization of AI-Related Technologies (AI Promotion Act, Act No. 53 of 2025)
framework.enforcing_body: AI Strategic Headquarters (Cabinet); sector ministries; Personal Information Protection Commission
framework.max_penalty: No direct penalties under the AI Promotion Act; APPI fines up to JPY 100 million for specified offences
framework.geographic_scope: Applies to businesses developing or using AI in Japan; cooperative duties rather than prohibitions.

source_documents.title: Understanding Japan's AI Promotion Act: An "Innovation-First" Blueprint

research.summary: Japan's AI Promotion Act (in force 1 September 2025) is a basic, promotion-oriented law with no penalties. It created an AI Strategic Headquarters chaired by the Prime Minister and requires national AI Basic Plans: the first was adopted on 23 December 2025 and a second on 14 July 2026. Business conduct is guided by the METI and MIC AI Guidelines for Business (April 2024); authorities can investigate, advise and publicly name non-compliant firms.

key_provisions.title: AI Basic Plan
key_provisions.description: Cabinet-approved plan reviewed in principle annually.

key_provisions.title: AI Strategic Headquarters
key_provisions.description: Prime Minister-chaired body coordinating national AI policy.

key_provisions.title: AI Guidelines for Business
key_provisions.description: Voluntary guidance from METI and MIC (April 2024).

cross_jurisdiction_tensions.tension: Japan's soft-law approach contrasts with the EU's binding obligations; exporters must meet EU rules regardless.

safety_risk_management.rationale: Risk handled through guidelines and heightened caution for high-impact uses; no mandatory assessment.

privacy_data_protection.rationale: APPI applies; no AI-specific data duties.

transparency.rationale: Voluntary transparency; government may disclose non-compliant entities.

gaps_and_weaknesses: No enforceable AI-specific duties or penalties.
research.monitor_notes: Verify against Japanese government sources; the second AI Basic Plan (14 July 2026) detail was not reviewed. Scores are provisional AI-drafted judgements against the AIETHOS rubric and reflect protections currently in force.

citizen.one_line: Japan encourages responsible AI through guidance and national plans rather than strict rules or fines.
citizen.what_changed: Since September 2025 Japan has a law that sets up national AI planning. Firms are asked to follow guidelines; the government can publicly name those that do not.
citizen.who_is_protected: People in Japan, mainly through existing privacy and consumer law.
who_is_not_protected: People harmed by AI where no existing law applies

your_rights.what_it_means: The APPI gives rights over personal data used in AI.
your_rights.how_to_invoke: Contact the company, then the Personal Information Protection Commission.

citizen.plain_language_summary: Japan's law promotes AI and relies on voluntary good practice, with privacy law as the main legal protection.

jargon_buster.Soft law: Guidance and principles that are not legally binding.
jargon_buster.APPI: Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information.
